response.justification: Strong senior full-stack profile with well over the required 6 years of experience, current hands-on TypeScript/Node.js work, and directly relevant AI-agent/MCP tooling experience — a rare and explicitly requested skill. Testing depth is exceptional (authored a D test runner and assertion library, taught TDD/Selenium courses), and cloud/container exposure (AWS CDK, Docker, Kubernetes) plus MongoDB/SQL matches the data and infra requirements. Main gaps are the absence of Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, and Kotlin, and a frontend history weighted toward Ember rather than React, but these are learnable adjacencies for someone with this breadth. Recommend interviewing with a focus on React depth and modern Node/Nest ecosystem familiarity.
strengths: 13+ years full-stack across TS/Node, plus current AI-agent and MCP tooling work
Deep testing and craftsmanship background: TDD, CI/CD, authored test frameworks
Broad polyglot and infra experience (Java, C/C++, D, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS)
concerns: No mention of Nest.js, Vitest, or Jest in the stated stack
React experience limited to one role; frontend history is mostly Ember.js
Kotlin absent and PostgreSQL not explicitly evidenced (MongoDB/MySQL instead)
